intro.title: Hi, I'm Mar Maestro!
intro.subtitle: Game Developer, Designer and Student.
body: I'm a 24-year-old student at Jaume I University currently studying Video Game Design and Development.
With hands-on experience in both programming and design, my work centers on analytical problem-solving and building solid technical foundations.
Passionate about crafting engaging player experiences, I'm constantly experimenting with new tools and techniques to bring interactive worlds to life.

skills.title: My Skills
skills.body: Through my studies and personal projects, I've gained a solid understanding of game development and other branches of computer engineering. I've applied and developed these skills in several projects.

portfolio.body: I love creating new things, and have been making games since I started university. Here are some projects worth checking out.

about.title: About Me
about.description: Contact section, and a little more about my trajectory.
about.headline: Systems architect, game designer, bird lover.
content: I'm a video game design and development student that loves to learn, create, and teach. My strength is programming, but I also enjoy creating, whether it be a system to implement, a plot to unravel or a mechanic to balance.

I make games for university and with my friends, along with other kinds of creative projects. You may see that I did indeed not code for most of my early projects. In the end, I'm a multidisciplinary programmer, ready for whatever is needed from my colleagues in other teams.
I love sharing my passions and feelings, and hearing about others'. Creating games is the best ways to do communicate this.

contact.title: Let's create something together
contact.body: Feel free to  reach out if you're looking for a game developer or designer, have a question, or just want to connect.
contact.message: I'll be glad to message back.
